map.内墙涂料达环保一等品: Interior wall coating reaches environmental first-class
map.：涂料类型选「内墙涂料」，VOC 50 g/L、甲醛 30 mg/kg、苯系物: : coating type "interior wall coating", VOC 50 g/L, formaldehyde 30 mg/kg, benzene series 50 mg/kg, lead 20 mg/kg. Interior limits are VOC 120, formaldehyde 100, benzene series 300, lead 90, so all four pass; and since VOC 50 falls in the 30~80 band it is judged environmental first-class under GB 18582.

map.环保等级是怎么分档的？: How are the environmental grades banded?
map.先要求 VOC、甲醛、苯系物、铅四项全部达到对应限值。全部达标且 VOC≤30: First require all four items — VOC, formaldehyde, benzene series and lead — to meet their limits. All compliant with VOC≤30 g/L is judged environmentally superior (green ten-ring grade); all compliant with VOC≤80 g/L is judged first-class environmental; only fully compliant is judged conforming; any exceedance means non-conforming.
map.为什么 VOC 限值按涂料类型不同？: Why do VOC limits differ by coating type?
map.不同用途涂料的配方与施工要求不同，国标给出的限量也不同：内墙涂料 GB 1858: Coatings for different uses have different formulations and application requirements, and the national standards set different limits: interior wall coating GB 18582 requires VOC≤120 g/L, exterior wall coating GB/T 9755 and waterproof coating GB/T 19250 are 200 g/L, wood furniture coating GB 18581 is 300 g/L. Picking the right type is the premise of judgement.
